summary: A public set of document templates that agents fill from facts the user provides.
problem: Agents change the document structure on every run and fill gaps with made-up numbers.

goals.text: Give agents a fixed document shape.
Ask for missing required facts instead of guessing.

users.need: A PRD with the same sections every time.

user_stories.action: get the same sections every time I ask for a PRD

requirements.text: A catalog lists every template with id, version, and file URLs.

open_questions.text: Which license to publish under is still open in the product PRD.
